simple.meaning: מֵן (mên) is a Hebrew word meaning “a part ; hence, a musical chord (as parted into strings).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מֵן (H4482) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 45:9, with occurrences in Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֵן (H4482) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מֵן (H4482) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מֵן (mên) / H4482 is traced through Psalms 45:9, Psalms 150:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a part ; hence, a musical chord (as parted into strings)
definitions.usage: in [the same] (Psalm 68:23), stringed instrument (Psalm 150:4), whereby (Psalm 45:8 [defective plural]).
definitions.full: H4482. men I. [ מֵן ] noun [masculine] string (of harp) (probably loan-word from Aramaic , hair, string PS 2163 ); plural מִנִּים Psa 150:4 , so also probably 45:9 (read מִנִּים for מִנִּי ᵑ0 , compare Che Bae We > Ges § 87 ,1.b Hup and others, who think מִנִּי an apocopatic plural) II. [ מֵן ], מִנֶּ֑הוּ see מנן II. [ מֵן ] noun [masculine] portion (Sim Hup and others); — מִנֶּה֑וּ Psa 68:24 , but read ( הָּ֯ ) מְנָתוֺ Ol Dy Bi Che We (see מְנָת above). — 45:9 ; 150:4 see I. מֵן above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to apportion ;
